parameters.formDescription: Please complete this form to request a clinic appointment.

parameters.query:
WITH requested AS (
    SELECT
        CAST($1 AS UNSIGNED) AS doctor_id,
        CAST($2 AS DATE) AS appointment_date,
        STR_TO_DATE($3, '%h:%i %p') AS appointment_time
)
SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM requested r
            JOIN appointment_slots s
              ON s.doctor_id = r.doctor_id
             AND s.appointment_date = r.appointment_date
             AND s.appointment_time = r.appointment_time
            WHERE s.status = 'BOOKED'
        )
        OR EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM requested r
            JOIN appointment_slots s
              ON s.doctor_id = r.doctor_id
             AND s.appointment_date = r.appointment_date
             AND s.appointment_time = r.appointment_time
            JOIN appointments a
              ON a.slot_id = s.slot_id
            WHERE a.status = 'CONFIRMED'
        )
        THEN 1
        ELSE 0
    END AS is_booked;

parameters.subject: Appointment Slot Unavailable – SmartClinic

parameters.query:
SELECT
    a.appointment_id,
    a.booking_ref,
    a.patient_id,
    a.slot_id,
    a.status,
    p.full_name,
    p.email,
    s.appointment_date,
    s.appointment_time
FROM appointments a
JOIN patients p
    ON a.patient_id = p.patient_id
JOIN appointment_slots s
    ON a.slot_id = s.slot_id
WHERE p.email = $1
AND a.slot_id = $2
ORDER BY a.appointment_id DESC
LIMIT 1;

INSERT INTO appointments
(booking_ref, patient_id, slot_id, status)
SELECT
    CONCAT(
        'SC-',
        UPPER(SUBSTRING(REPLACE(UUID(), '-', ''), 1, 24))
    ),
    p.patient_id,
    $1,
    'CONFIRMED'
FROM patients p
WHERE p.email = $2
ORDER BY p.patient_id DESC
LIMIT 1;

INSERT INTO appointment_slots
(doctor_id, appointment_date, appointment_time, status)
SELECT
    $1,
    $2,
    STR_TO_DATE($3, '%h:%i %p'),
    'AVAILABLE'
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM appointment_slots
    WHERE doctor_id = $4
    AND appointment_date = $5
    AND appointment_time = STR_TO_DATE($6, '%h:%i %p')
);

    doctor_id,
    appointment_date,
    appointment_time,
    status
FROM appointment_slots
WHERE doctor_id = $1
AND appointment_date = $2
AND appointment_time = STR_TO_DATE($3, '%h:%i %p')
AND status = 'AVAILABLE'
ORDER BY slot_id DESC
LIMIT 1;
